proof:
subst h₀ h₁
simp only at h₃
-- n has 2 digits, so 10 ≤ n < 100
have hn : 10 ≤ n ∧ n < 100 := by
  constructor
  · by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    interval_cases n <;> simp_all (config := { decide := true })
  · by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have : (Nat.digits 10 n).length ≥ 3 := by
      have : 100 ≤ n := h
      clear h₃ h₂
      have h10 : 1 < 10 := by norm_num
      have := Nat.le_digits_len_le 10 100 n this
      simp [Nat.digits] at this
      omega
    omega
obtain ⟨h10, h100⟩ := hn
interval_cases n <;> simp_all (config := { decide := true }) <;> omega
